name: Fuchsia Gym (Koga Duel)
summary: Step into Fuchsia City Gym, protected by an intricate maze of invisible glass walls. Battle through Ninja Tamers and Jugglers to reach the inner sanctum. When challenged, select your 4 designated Pokémon from your active party to challenge Ninja Master Koga to a 4v4 battle for the Soul Badge under the Level 42 cap.

items.name: Soul Badge
items.method: Defeat Gym Leader Koga in a 4v4 arena battle

items.name: TM06 Toxic
items.method: Reward from Koga upon earning the Soul Badge

navigation_notes: Follow the perimeter walls clockwise and look closely for slight floor seams to navigate the invisible maze.
Hard Mode Rule: Party size must strictly match Koga's 4 active members (4 vs 4). Box your 5th and 6th slots before speaking to Koga.
Equip Pecha Berries or Antidotes on all duelists to mitigate turn-1 Toxic and Sludge Bomb poison status.
